# cpanel_account_capabilities (Data Source)

Reads cPanel account identity, limits, version, and feature availability without exposing contact details, tokens, UUIDs, or other sensitive account fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_account_capabilities" "current" {}

locals {
  passenger_available = data.cpanel_account_capabilities.current.features["passengerapps"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) The singleton account identity, always `account`.
- `cpanel_version` (String) The complete cPanel version and build string.
- `disabled_features` (Set of String) The disabled cPanel feature names.
- `enabled_features` (Set of String) The enabled cPanel feature names.
- `features` (Map of Boolean) Every cPanel feature name and whether it is enabled. Use this map for Terraform preconditions on optional cPanel modules.
- `home_directory` (String) The absolute cPanel account home directory.
- `limits` (Map of String) Selected account limits exactly as reported by cPanel. Values can be numeric strings or `unlimited`.
- `plan` (String) The account plan reported by cPanel.
- `primary_domain` (String) The primary domain assigned to the cPanel account.
- `shell` (String) The account login shell reported by cPanel.
- `theme` (String) The account theme reported by cPanel.
- `username` (String) The cPanel account username.
